text: Yes, the school should adopt the later start time. With full crossing-guard coverage confirmed for the shifted schedule, students can arrive home safer and more protected. The initiative also makes our district the first statewide to adopt this model, showcasing our commitment to innovation and progress. Furthermore, a bus route consolidation under the new times saves us forty thousand dollars annually, which can be utilized towards other educational resources. Additionally, the pilot school has seen significant improvements in attendance every term since switching, demonstrating the positive impact on student engagement and learning.
